presented_reader: one step on reconstruction-kept root only
comparison_reader: one step on mean roots for compose, otherwise kept root
reader_mse_timing: per sentence before either update, on reconstruction-kept roots
reader_mse_final_gate: unchanged ordinary evaluation using presented reader only

miss_diagnostics.late_flip: stable all-conjunction after epoch 100, with actual epochs remaining reported; descriptive rather than causal attribution
miss_diagnostics.reader_plateau: correct labels, early conjunction, and active reader norm changes at most 1 percent in final 50 epochs
miss_diagnostics.anything_else: all remaining misses, reporting norm growth, MSE curve and late costs

identity.hash: SHA256 first eight bytes, little endian; private NumPy generator
identity.projection: private generator, SHA256(word-identity-projection-v1), normal (D+L) by d / sqrt(d)
identity.mint: first differing positional triple, grow its own bit stream from s to D; next position, then quadruples
